{{Quote|Obrio Caldori is a mid-level operative but he's not part of Black Sun's muscle, he's more like an administrator.|Corran Horn to a spacer|<ref name="An Empire Divided" />}}
'''Obrio Caldori''' was [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Bothan/Legends|Bothan]] who became involved with the [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] crime syndicate, rising to a position as a mid-level administrator during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Sometime following [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]], [[Agent/Legends|Agent]] [[Corran Horn/Legends|Corran Horn]] of the [[Corellian Security Force]] had Caldori arrested for questioning as part of an investigation. When he realized how much information CorSec already had during his interrogation, Caldori provided all the evidence he had, implicating [[Voydd Blancken]].<ref name="An Empire Divided" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:TemplateCommonerBothanMale.png|250px|thumb|Possible depictions of Obrio Caldori]]
Obrio Caldori was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] [[Star Wars Galaxies|''Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided'']], a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]], prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].
